∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : OracleTemplate.Muon.Public) (N : ℕ),
  q.T = N + 1 →
    1 ≤ q.B →
      ∀ (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
        (g : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n) (j : Fin (N + 1)) (tape : ℕ → Ω),
        OracleTemplate.execute (OracleTemplate.Muon.sampleOracle P g) (outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.randomMuon q N)
            (fun x => q.T * q.B) j tape =
          (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g tape ↑j).2.1
